newsitem.title: USA: Dow seen opening steady to higher after CPI data.
newsitem.headline: Dow seen opening steady to higher after CPI data.

text.p: U.S. stocks were seen opening steady to higher on Tuesday after the May consumer price index met Wall Street's expectations.
"The CPI data is a stable figure," said Pierre Ellis, senior economist at Primark Decision Economics.
"The Fed will be happy with this. Inflation is status quo despite all the ground the economy has covered. Stocks will likely open steady," he added.
The Labor Department reported the CPI rose 0.1 percent. Economists in a Reuter survey had expected a 0.2 percent increase.
U.S. blue chips snapped a six session run of record closes on Monday when the Dow closed down just under 10 points at 7,772.09.
